name: core-runtime-async-context-tail-api67
notes: Direct deterministic local Queueable and Schedulable callbacks drained by Test.stopTest; zero hosted Salesforce parity and no worker lifecycle claim.
salesforceExclusionReason: Deterministic local async callbacks have zero hosted Salesforce parity and are not a worker lifecycle oracle.

source.content: public class AsyncContextTailQueue implements Queueable { public static String observed; public void execute(QueueableContext context) { observed = context.getJobId(); } }
public class AsyncContextTailSchedule implements Schedulable { public static String observed; public void execute(SchedulableContext context) { observed = context.getTriggerId(); } }

@IsTest private class AsyncContextTailTest { @IsTest static void callbacksDrainAtStopTest() { Test.startTest(); String queueId = System.enqueueJob(new AsyncContextTailQueue()); String triggerId = System.schedule('lifecycle-tail', '0 0 0 * * ?', new AsyncContextTailSchedule()); System.assertEquals('707000000000001', queueId); System.assertEquals('08e000000000002', triggerId); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(queueId, AsyncContextTailQueue.observed); System.assertEquals(triggerId, AsyncContextTailSchedule.observed); } }
